content_sections.heading: About NIOT
content_sections.text: NIOT is an institution under the Earth System Sciences Council (ESSC), an autonomous body under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, Govt. of India. Located in Chennai, it promotes technology development in mission mode activities in Ocean Engineering and Ocean Resource utilization.

content_sections.heading: NIOT Manager Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age must not exceed 45 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. The same closing date decides whether a candidate meets the qualification and experience requirements. A Master Degree from a recognized University. Operational computer knowledge. 6 years' experience preferably in Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies in the relevant area in Pay Level-8/Pay Level-9 or its equivalent. MBA/LLB/Diploma in Management/CA/ICWA/SAS or equivalent. The applicant must be a citizen of India. Qualifications should have been obtained through recognized Universities or Institutions. Experience in the relevant area is counted after the date of acquiring the minimum prescribed educational qualifications. Experience on part-time basis, casual/daily wages, as free lancers and the like is not counted for short listing. A candidate claiming an equivalent qualification must produce the order or letter, with number and date, showing the authority under which it is so treated. Otherwise the claim will not be considered and the application is liable to be rejected. The appointment of a PwBD candidate is subject to medical fitness under the Government standards for the post. PwBD and women candidates who meet the eligibility conditions are encouraged to apply. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Manager Duties and Job Requirement
content_sections.text: The Manager shall be responsible for these duties in the assigned functional area:

rows.duties: Recruitment, promotions, and engagement of contractual and project staff; posting, transfer, leave and terminal benefits; discipline and vigilance matters; coordination with concerned departments
Organizational policies in line with Government of India guidelines; compliance with rules, regulations and circulars
Adherence to organizational policies and Government directives; RTI matters and legal proceedings; security, safety and Official Language Policy
Procurement through GeM, CPPP and Global Tenders; Notice Inviting Tenders (NITs); contract management and vendor performance monitoring
Resource allocation plans; inventory and asset registers; write-off and disposal of unserviceable goods
Budget proposals; accounts maintenance; payments and advances; imprest settlement; audit observations and queries
Day-to-day management of assigned functions; inter-departmental coordination; records and documentation; periodic reporting to senior management

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Short-listing: a duly constituted Screening Committee adopts its own criteria. If applications are large in number, NIOT may restrict the candidates called for interview to a reasonable limit, using one or more suitable criteria. Screening list: the list of screened in/screened out applicants will be notified on the NIOT website. Interview: selection is by interview of the shortlisted candidates. Meeting the essential qualifications does not by itself entitle a candidate to an interview. Mention all qualifications and experience in the relevant area beyond the prescribed minimum in the application, with supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Pay and allowances: the post carries basic pay and usual allowances, including Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA) and Transport Allowance (TA), as admissible to employees of Central Autonomous Bodies. Increment: an employee is eligible for annual increment as per rules. Other benefits: Leave, New Pension Scheme, reimbursement of Medical Expenses, Leave Travel Concession, Children Education Allowance and Newspaper allowance are available as per Rules. Posting: the appointment will be at the NIOT Headquarters at Chennai. Appointees are liable to be posted to any field unit of NIOT in India on administrative exigencies. Probation: two years from the date of taking over charge of the post. It may be extended at the discretion of the Competent Authority, and confirmation is considered after successful completion, in accordance with the extant rules.

faq.question: Q1. Is an MBA compulsory for the NIOT Manager post?
faq.answer: No. MBA, LLB, Diploma in Management, CA, ICWA and SAS are desirable. The essential degree is a Master Degree from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q2. Can SC, ST or OBC candidates get age relaxation?
faq.answer: No. The single vacancy is Unreserved, so these candidates must meet the 45-year limit and compete in the standards of the Unreserved category.

faq.question: Q3. Does contract or part-time experience count?
faq.answer: Part-time, casual/daily wage and free lancer experience is not counted for short listing. The notice does not list contract work among these exclusions.

faq.question: Q4. Can a Central Government employee get extra age relaxation?
faq.answer: Yes. Regular employees of NIOT or Central Government Departments can get up to five years if their post is in the same line or allied cadres and their service is useful for this post.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the selected Manager work?
faq.answer: The appointment will be at the NIOT Headquarters at Chennai, though the appointee can be posted to any NIOT field unit in India.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the probation period?
faq.answer: Probation is two years from the date of taking over charge, and the Competent Authority may extend it.

faq.question: Q7. How will shortlisted candidates receive the interview call?
faq.answer: The call letter will be sent to the candidate's registered e-mail. The screened in/screened out list will appear on the NIOT website.

faq.question: Q8. Will NIOT pay travel expenses for the interview?
faq.answer: Only outstation SC/ST candidates shortlisted for interview are paid to-and-fro second-class rail fare. It is paid from the place of journey or normal residence, whichever is nearer to Chennai Central Railway station, on production of train tickets or other proof of journey, including bus tickets.
